    tokens = []

    while i < n:
        c = source[i]

            i += 1
        elif c == ';':
            while i < n and source[i] != '\n':
                i += 1
        elif c == '(':
            tokens.append(('(', None))
            i += 1
        elif c == ')':
            tokens.append((')', None))
            i += 1
        elif c == "'":
            tokens.append(("'", None))
            i += 1
        elif c == '"':
            i += 1
            parts = []
            while i < n and source[i] != '"':
                if source[i] == '\\':
                    i += 1
                    if i >= n:
                        raise SyntaxError("unterminated string escape")
                    nc = source[i]
                    if nc == '"':
                        parts.append('"')
                    elif nc == '\\':
                        parts.append('\\')
                    elif nc == 'n':
                        parts.append('\n')
                    else:
                        raise SyntaxError(f"invalid escape: \\{nc}")
                else:
                    parts.append(source[i])
                i += 1
            if i >= n:
                raise SyntaxError("unterminated string")
            i += 1  # skip closing "
            tokens.append(('string', ''.join(parts)))
        else:
            # read atom token
            start = i
            while i < n and source[i] not in ' \t\n\r()";\'':
                i += 1
            tokens.append(('atom', source[start:i]))
